incidents.title: Unencrypted PII Data Detected in Public S3 Bucket
incidents.description: Automated scan #SCAN-RAM-2026-001 discovered 1,247 customer records containing unencrypted credit card numbers (PAN) and CVV codes in s3://dhcaas-client-logs-public. Immediate remediation required per CNDP 09-08 Article 24 and PCI-DSS 3.2.1.

incidents.title: GDPR Article 5 Violation - Data Retention Policy Breach
incidents.description: Compliance engine detected 34,890 customer records in 'Legacy_Customer_DB' (PostgreSQL) exceeding GDPR's 5-year data retention limit. Records date back to 2018-2019 without valid legal basis for extended storage.

incidents.title: Data Quality Degradation - 18% Null Values in Critical Fields
incidents.description: Quality monitoring detected significant increase in null values for 'customer_email' (18.4%) and 'phone_number' (22.7%) fields in CRM database over the past 72 hours. Baseline threshold exceeded by 300%.

incidents.title: Schema Drift Detected in Analytics Warehouse
incidents.description: Automated schema validation identified 3 undocumented column additions in 'customer_transactions' table. Changes made outside of standard change management process.
incidents.resolution_notes: Schema changes documented retroactively. Added to data catalog. Process improvement ticket created (JIRA-4521).

incidents.title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Without Adequate Safeguards
incidents.description: Data lineage analysis revealed customer data from EU citizens being transferred to US-based servers without Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or BCRs. Violates GDPR Article 46.
